defs.def: to put an end to an argument or a disagreement 结束（争论、争端等）；解决（分歧、纠纷等）

ex.s: The disagreement was too sharp that neither he nor I knew what to settle it.
ex.t: 分歧太尖锐了，他和我都不知道如何解决。

ex.s: Everyone in the family settled quickly into the city except me.
ex.t: 除了我之外，家里的每个人都很快适应了这个城市。

ex.s: The Habima is the centre of Hebrew-language theatre worldwide, Founded in Moscow after the 1905 revolution, the company eventually settled in Tel Aviv in the late 1920s.
ex.t: 哈比马是全球希伯来语戏剧的中心，成立于1905年革命后的莫斯科，该公司于20世纪20年代末最终定居特拉维夫。

ex.s: What will the woman do to settle the problem about the fridge?
ex.t: 这位女士要如何解决冰箱的问题？

ex.s: The Habima is the centre of Hebrew-language theatre worldwide ,Founded in Moscow after the 1905 revolution, the company eventually settled in Tel Aviv in the late 1920s,Since 1958, they have been recognised as the national theatre of Israel .This production of Shakespeare’s The Merchant of Venice marks their first visit to the UK.

defs.def: to decide or arrange sth finally （最终）决定，确定，安排好

ex.s: What made Reisley finally decide to settle down in Usonia?
ex.t: 是什么让Reisley最终决定在Usonia定居？

defs.def: to make a place your permanent home 定居

ex.s: It’s been an honor to watch the panda programme develop ___64___ to see the pandas settle into their new home.
ex.t: 能见证熊猫项目的发展___64___并看到熊猫们在新家安顿下来，我深感荣幸。

defs.def: to make your permanent home in a country or an area as colonists 一批人
to make yourself or sb else comfortable in a new position 使处于舒适的位置

ex.s: As our ___47___ day drew near, I settled on a new price ($0) and reposted it.
ex.t: 我无数次地争论说，比较是"快乐的窃贼"。

defs.def: to put sth carefully in a position so that it does not move 把 … 放好；安放
to become or make sb/sth become calm or relaxed （使）平静下来，安静下来，定下心来

ex.s: Microplastics have become a common source of pollution across the Earth — they have settled in the deep sea and on the Himalayas, stuck inside volcanic rocks, filled the stomachs of seabirds and even fallen in fresh Antarctic snow.
Soon afterwards, many of those people started settling down to become farmers, and their languages too became more settled and fewer in number.
ex.t: 不久之后，其中许多人开始定居成为农民，他们的语言也变得更加稳定，数量也减少了。

defs.def: to fall from above and come to rest on sth; to stay for some time on sth 降落；停留

ex.s: The city was crowded with disappointed people with no interest in settling down, and when they heard there were new gold discoveries in Alaska, they left Dawson City as quickly as they had come.
ex.t: 许多来访者惊叹于复杂的建筑空间和丰富的建筑类型。

defs.def: to sink slowly down; to make sth do this （使）沉降，下陷，变得密实

ex.s: Much is still to be settled, but here are some of the solutions to get us going green.
ex.t: "我真的想让这对____人们的日常生活都适用，而且我知道这不总是意味着在特别周末之后的周一____归还一条裙子，"她说。

ex.s: People settle in these places because they are easy to get to and naturally suited to communications and trade.
ex.t: 许多人离开道森的主要原因是什么？

defs.def: to pay the money that you owe 付清（欠款）；结算；结账
to get into a comfortable position, either sitting or lying 舒适地坐下（或躺下）
to start to have a quieter way of life, living in one place （在某地）定居下来，过安定的生活

ex.s: Accepting sadness as part of life helps Riley deal with the emotional complexity of growing up, and settle down in her new life.
ex.t: 接受悲伤作为生活的一部分，帮助Riley应对成长中的情感复杂性，并在新生活中安定下来。

ex.s: There was a great difference of opinion, at first, as to the course or direction the earthquake traveled, but water that splashed out of various tanks and buckets settled that.
ex.t: 起初，关于地震传播的方向存在很大分歧，但从各种水箱和水桶中溅出的水解决了这个问题。

ex.s: He woke up from his apparent stupor at the day and hour when the rents were due, or when accounts had to be settled with his vine-dressers, and receipts given.
ex.t: 他在收租的日子或是必须与葡萄园工人结账、开具收据的日子和时间，才会从表面上的昏沉中醒来。

ex.s: Historically, Chinese immigrants settled in the area during the railroad construction and gold rush period.
ex.t: 历史上，在铁路建设和淘金热时期，中国移民在这一地区定居下来。

ex.s: Understand implied meaning The two gentlemen had been having a heated argument for a couple of days, and had decided to make a which would settle their argument.
ex.t: 理解隐含意义 两位绅士已经激烈争论了好几天，他们决定做一次 来解决他们的争论。
